```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# NACCS prolonged cranial surgery service evaluation
# Reproducible analysis script
# Input: original survey export 'RAW DATA - naccs.csv' (NOT for public distribution)
# Output: aggregate summaries only, in 'analysis_outputs/'
# All durations are minutes. Quartiles use median-of-halves, NOT stats::quantile(type=7).

# 0. Dependencies -------------------------------------------------------------
# install.packages(c('readr','dplyr','tidyr','stringr','ggplot2','tibble'))
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
dir.create('analysis_outputs', showWarnings = FALSE)
```


```{r import_data, include=FALSE}
# 1. Import and retain original row identifiers -------------------------------
source_data <- read_csv('RAW DATA - naccs.csv', show_col_types = FALSE)
stopifnot(ncol(source_data) == 28L, nrow(source_data) == 145L)
colnames(source_data) <- c(
  'submitted_date','hospital','month','procedure','indication',
  'anticipated_duration','actual_duration','drugs','pharma_prop','other1',
  'pharma_remi','anaesthesia','other2','patient_factors','surgical_factors',
  'anaesthetic_factors','other3','scalp_block','planned_postop','actual_postop',
  'timetowake','hydrocephalus','recoverytime','complications','comments',
  'formname','created','modified'
)
source_data <- source_data %>% mutate(CaseID = row_number())
```


```{r data_cleaning, include=FALSE}
# 2. Data cleaning and cohort selection --------------------------------------
# Treat common text representations of missing values as NA.
clean_na_strings <- function(df) {
  df %>% mutate(across(where(is.character), function(x) {
    x <- trimws(x)
    x[x %in% c('', 'NA', 'N/A', 'na', 'n/a', 'N/a')] <- NA_character_
    x
  }))
}

raw_data <- clean_na_strings(source_data) %>%
  mutate(
    anticipated_duration = as.numeric(anticipated_duration),
    actual_duration = as.numeric(actual_duration),
    timetowake = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(timetowake)),
    recoverytime = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(recoverytime))
  )

# Four cases have missing actual surgical duration.
# These values are retained as missing and are not imputed.
# Anticipated duration is retained separately for eligibility assessment.
missing_actual_ids <- raw_data$CaseID[is.na(raw_data$actual_duration)]
stopifnot(length(missing_actual_ids) == 4L)
raw_data <- raw_data %>%
  mutate(
    actual_duration_missing = is.na(actual_duration)
  )

# Exclude cases where both anticipated and actual durations were < 480 min.
# Retain cases with missing actual duration if anticipated duration >= 480 min.

short_cases <- raw_data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(anticipated_duration),
    !is.na(actual_duration),
    anticipated_duration < 480,
    actual_duration < 480
  )

stopifnot(nrow(short_cases) == 4L)

raw_data <- raw_data %>%
  filter(!CaseID %in% short_cases$CaseID)

# Exclude the spinal (non-cranial) procedure identified during data review.
spinal_cases <- raw_data %>%
  filter(str_detect(coalesce(procedure, ''),
                    regex('revision of anterior cervical decompression', ignore_case = TRUE)))
stopifnot(nrow(spinal_cases) == 1L)
raw_data <- raw_data %>%
  filter(!CaseID %in% spinal_cases$CaseID)
stopifnot(nrow(raw_data) == 140L, n_distinct(raw_data$CaseID) == 140L)

# Do NOT remove a record just because hospital, drugs or anaesthesia is missing.
# Anonymised hospital labels are for internal analysis only; never export key.
hospital_levels <- sort(unique(na.omit(raw_data$hospital)))
raw_data <- raw_data %>%
  mutate(hospanon = factor(hospital, levels = hospital_levels,
                          labels = LETTERS[seq_along(hospital_levels)]))
```


```{r summary_functions, include=FALSE}
# 3. Descriptive statistics helpers ------------------------------------------
median_halves <- function(x, half = c('lower','upper')) {
  half <- match.arg(half)
  x <- sort(x[!is.na(x)])
  n <- length(x)
  if (n < 2L) return(NA_real_)
  h <- floor(n / 2)
  if (half == 'lower') median(head(x, h)) else median(tail(x, h))
}

summarise_numeric <- function(df, variable) {
  x <- df[[variable]]
  tibble(n_recorded = sum(!is.na(x)),
         median = if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
         Q1 = median_halves(x, 'lower'), Q3 = median_halves(x, 'upper'),
         minimum = if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else min(x, na.rm = TRUE),
         maximum = if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else max(x, na.rm = TRUE))
}

techniques <- c('Desflurane', 'Sevoflurane', 'TIVA')
known_technique <- raw_data %>% filter(anaesthesia %in% techniques)
stopifnot(nrow(known_technique) == 139L,
          sum(known_technique$anaesthesia == 'Desflurane') == 11L,
          sum(known_technique$anaesthesia == 'Sevoflurane') == 17L,
          sum(known_technique$anaesthesia == 'TIVA') == 111L,
          sum(!is.na(known_technique$timetowake)) == 128L)
```


```{r table1, include=FALSE}
# 4. Manuscript Table 1: duration and emergence by maintenance technique -----
make_table1 <- function(df) {
  df %>% group_by(anaesthesia) %>%
    group_modify(~{
      duration <- summarise_numeric(.x, 'actual_duration')
      emergence <- summarise_numeric(.x, 'timetowake')
      tibble(n = nrow(.x), n_emergence = emergence$n_recorded,
             duration_median = duration$median, duration_Q1 = duration$Q1,
             duration_Q3 = duration$Q3, duration_min = duration$minimum,
             duration_max = duration$maximum,
             emergence_median = emergence$median, emergence_Q1 = emergence$Q1,
             emergence_Q3 = emergence$Q3, emergence_min = emergence$minimum,
             emergence_max = emergence$maximum)
    }) %>% ungroup()
}

table1_by_technique <- make_table1(known_technique)
table1_total <- make_table1(known_technique %>% mutate(anaesthesia = 'Total'))
table1 <- bind_rows(table1_by_technique, table1_total)
print(table1, width = Inf)
write_csv(table1, 'analysis_outputs/table1_duration_emergence.csv')
# Overall 140-case surgical duration (separate from Table 1's 139-case total).
overall_140_duration <- summarise_numeric(raw_data, 'actual_duration')
print(overall_140_duration)
```


```{r descriptive_counts, include=FALSE}
# 5. Hospital counts, drug use and reported reasons ---------------------------
# These summaries keep one row per CaseID; avoid splitting rows then using n().
hospital_counts <- raw_data %>% count(hospanon, name = 'n_cases')
print(hospital_counts)
write_csv(hospital_counts, 'analysis_outputs/hospital_counts.csv')

# Split multiple selections into long format and count DISTINCT cases.
# Comma-separated drug labels include 'morphine, oxycodone'; this split therefore
# produces a spurious 'oxycodone' token, removed below. Validate against questionnaire.
drug_counts <- raw_data %>%
  select(CaseID, drugs) %>%
  separate_rows(drugs, sep = ',') %>%
  mutate(drug = str_trim(drugs)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(drug), drug != '', drug != 'oxycodone') %>%
  distinct(CaseID, drug) %>% count(drug, name = 'n_cases', sort = TRUE)
print(drug_counts, n = Inf)
write_csv(drug_counts, 'analysis_outputs/drug_counts.csv')

reason_counts <- raw_data %>%
  select(CaseID, anaesthesia, patient_factors, surgical_factors, anaesthetic_factors) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(patient_factors, surgical_factors, anaesthetic_factors),
               names_to = 'factor_type', values_to = 'reason') %>%
  separate_rows(reason, sep = ',') %>%
  mutate(reason = str_trim(reason)) %>%
  filter(anaesthesia %in% techniques, !is.na(reason), reason != '') %>%
  distinct(CaseID, anaesthesia, reason) %>%
  count(anaesthesia, reason, name = 'n_cases') %>%
  left_join(known_technique %>% count(anaesthesia, name = 'denominator'),
            by = 'anaesthesia') %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * n_cases / denominator)
print(reason_counts, n = Inf)
write_csv(reason_counts, 'analysis_outputs/reasons_for_technique.csv')
```

```{r primary_emergence, include=FALSE}
primary_emergence <- known_technique %>%
```

```{r}
# Figure 1: Anaesthetic practice across participating hospitals --------------

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)

dir.create("analysis_outputs", showWarnings = FALSE)

technique_order <- c("Desflurane", "Sevoflurane", "TIVA")

technique_colours <- c(
  "Desflurane"  = "#F8766D",
  "Sevoflurane" = "#00BA38",
  "TIVA"        = "#619CFF",
  "Unknown"     = "#888888"
)

# FIGURE 1A: Maintenance technique by hospital -------------------------------

hospital_technique <- raw_data %>%
  mutate(
    technique = if_else(
      anaesthesia %in% technique_order,
      anaesthesia,
      "Unknown"
    ),
    technique = factor(
      technique,
      levels = c(technique_order, "Unknown")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(hospanon)) %>%
  count(hospanon, technique, name = "n_cases") %>%
  group_by(hospanon) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * n_cases / sum(n_cases)) %>%
  ungroup()

figure1a <- ggplot(
  hospital_technique,
  aes(x = hospanon, y = percent, fill = technique)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = technique_colours, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Hospital",
    y = "Cases (%)",
    fill = "Maintenance technique"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(figure1a)

ggsave(
  "analysis_outputs/Figure_1a.png",
  figure1a, width = 10, height = 5.5, dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  "analysis_outputs/Figure_1a.pdf",
  figure1a, width = 10, height = 5.5
)


# FIGURE 1B: Reasons for maintenance technique -------------------------------

reason_order <- c(
  "Anaesthetist preference",
  "Comorbidities",
  "Duration of surgery",
  "Elderly",
  "Facilitate intra-operative neuromonitoring (IONM)",
  "Obesity",
  "Theatre efficiency",
  "Transfer for intra-operative radiology"
)

reason_colours <- c(
  "Anaesthetist preference" = "#F8766D",
  "Comorbidities" = "#D89000",
  "Duration of surgery" = "#7CAE00",
  "Elderly" = "#00BF7D",
  "Facilitate intra-operative neuromonitoring (IONM)" = "#00BFC4",
  "Obesity" = "#00B0F6",
  "Theatre efficiency" = "#C77CFF",
  "Transfer for intra-operative radiology" = "#F564E3"
)

figure1b_data <- reason_counts %>%
  filter(reason %in% reason_order) %>%
  mutate(
    anaesthesia = factor(anaesthesia, levels = technique_order),
    reason = factor(reason, levels = reason_order)
  )

figure1b <- ggplot(
  figure1b_data,
  aes(x = anaesthesia, y = percent, fill = reason)
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.85),
    width = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = reason_colours, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 105),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")
  ) +

    x = "Maintenance technique",
    y = "Cases reporting reason (%)",
    fill = "Reason"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +

    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1)
  )

print(figure1b)

ggsave(
  "analysis_outputs/Figure_1b.png",
  figure1b, width = 11, height = 6, dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  "analysis_outputs/Figure_1b.pdf",

# Combine Figure 1a and Figure 1b --------------------------------------------

library(patchwork)

# Remove individual titles and add panel labels
figure1a <- figure1a +
  labs(title = NULL) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5))

figure1b <- figure1b +
  labs(title = NULL) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5))

# Combine side by side
figure1 <- (
  figure1a + figure1b +
    plot_layout(
      ncol = 2,
      widths = c(1.1, 1.3)
    )
) +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "a",
    tag_prefix = "(",
    tag_suffix = ")"
  ) &
  theme(
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.tag.position = c(0.01, 0.99)
  )

# Display
print(figure1)

# Save combined figure
# Combine Figure 1a and Figure 1b — equal-width panels -----------------------

library(patchwork)

# Figure 1a: retain legend on the right
figure1a_final <- figure1a +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
  )

# Figure 1b: move legend below to free horizontal space
figure1b_final <- figure1b +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
  )

# Combine with equal panel widths
figure1 <- (
  figure1a_final | figure1b_final
) +
  plot_layout(
    widths = c(1, 1)
  ) +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "a",
    tag_prefix = "(",
    tag_suffix = ")"
  ) &
  theme(
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    plot.tag.position = c(0.01, 0.99)
  )

print(figure1)

# Save
ggsave(
  "analysis_outputs/Figure_1_combined.pdf",
  plot = figure1,
  width = 14,
  height = 6,
  units = "in"
)

ggsave(
  "analysis_outputs/Figure_1_combined.png",
  plot = figure1,
  width = 14,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)
```


```{r mixed_sensitivity, include=FALSE}
# 7. Mixed TIVA / sevoflurane sensitivity analysis ----------------------------
#
# Mixed-technique cases were identified using two sources:
#
# 1. Structured responses indicating both propofol TCI and sevoflurane.
# 2. Free-text responses in 'other3' describing sevoflurane use
#    alongside propofol.
#
# All cases identified by either method were included in the
# mixed-technique sensitivity analysis, irrespective of their
# recorded predominant maintenance technique.
#
# Fifteen cases were identified: 12 through structured responses
# and three additional cases through free text.
#
# The primary analysis retains these cases according to their
# recorded predominant maintenance technique.
# The sensitivity analysis excludes them.
#
# Case-level adjudication records are retained privately and
# are not included in public analysis outputs.
structured_candidates <- raw_data %>%
  filter(str_detect(coalesce(drugs, ''), fixed('Propofol target controlled infusion (TCI)')),
         str_detect(coalesce(drugs, ''), regex('Sevoflurane', ignore_case = TRUE)))
stopifnot(nrow(structured_candidates) == 12L)

# FREE TEXT: low-dose sevoflurane introduced after reduction of propofol.
free_text_candidates <- raw_data %>%
  filter(str_detect(coalesce(other3, ''), regex('sevoflurane', ignore_case = TRUE)))
stopifnot(nrow(free_text_candidates) == 3L)

# Include all cases reporting both agents, including CaseID 141.
# 12 structured candidates + 3 additional free-text cases = 15.
mixed_case_ids <- sort(unique(c(
  structured_candidates$CaseID,
  free_text_candidates$CaseID
)))

stopifnot(length(mixed_case_ids) == 15L)


mixed_sensitivity <- known_technique %>%
  filter(!CaseID %in% mixed_case_ids,
         anaesthesia %in% c('TIVA', 'Sevoflurane')) %>%
  group_by(anaesthesia) %>%
  group_modify(~bind_cols(tibble(n = nrow(.x)), summarise_numeric(.x, 'timetowake'))) %>%
  ungroup()
print(mixed_sensitivity, width = Inf)
write_csv(mixed_sensitivity, 'analysis_outputs/sensitivity_mixed_technique.csv')
```


```{r duration_sensitivity, include=FALSE}
# 8. Unexpectedly prolonged cases sensitivity analysis -----------------------
# Anticipated < 480 min, actual >= 480 min. >= rather than > matches current analysis.
unexpectedly_prolonged <- known_technique %>%
  filter(anticipated_duration < 480, actual_duration >= 480)
stopifnot(nrow(unexpectedly_prolonged) == 14L)
print(unexpectedly_prolonged %>% count(anaesthesia))
# Expected excluded: Desflurane 2, Sevoflurane 3, TIVA 9.

duration_sensitivity <- known_technique %>%
filter(!CaseID %in% unexpectedly_prolonged$CaseID)  %>%
  group_by(anaesthesia) %>%
  group_modify(~bind_cols(tibble(n = nrow(.x)), summarise_numeric(.x, 'timetowake'))) %>%
  ungroup()
print(duration_sensitivity, width = Inf)
write_csv(duration_sensitivity, 'analysis_outputs/sensitivity_unexpected_duration.csv')
# Expected: Desflurane n=9, recorded=9, median 8, Q1 7, Q3 10.5;
# Sevoflurane n=14, recorded=13, median 25, Q1 10, Q3 52.5;
# TIVA n=102, recorded=93, median 15, Q1 9.5, Q3 22.5.
```

```{r}
# TABLE S1: Centre-level case capture ----------------------------------------

library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)

table_s1 <- tribble(
  ~Hospital_ID, ~Cases_Submitted, ~Eligible_Confirmed,
  "A",   1, NA_real_,
  "B",   6, 6,
  "C",   2, 2,
  "D",  21, 21,
  "E",   6, 7,
  "F",  10, 10,
  "G",  16, 16,
  "H",   1, 1,
  "I",   6, 8,
  "J",   6, 6,
  "K",   3, 3,
  "L",   4, 6,
  "M",   2, 2,
  "N",   1, 1,
  "O",   3, 3,
  "P",   8, 12,
  "Q",   1, NA_real_,
"R",  2, 2,
"S",  1, 1,
"T", 29, 29,
"U",  4, NA_real_,
"V",  4, 5,
"W",  2, 2,
"X",  0, 0,
"Y",  0, 0,
"Z",  0, 0,
"AA", 0, 0
) %>%
  mutate(
    Case_Capture_Percent = if_else(
      !is.na(Eligible_Confirmed) & Eligible_Confirmed > 0,
      round(100 * Cases_Submitted / Eligible_Confirmed, 1),
      NA_real_
    )
  )

print(table_s1, n = Inf)

write_csv(
  table_s1,
  "analysis_outputs/Table_S1_case_capture.csv"
)
# Verify centre-level counts against eligible case-level data

centre_audit <- raw_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(hospanon)) %>%
  count(Hospital_ID = as.character(hospanon),
        name = "Actual_Count") %>%
  full_join(
    table_s1 %>%
      select(Hospital_ID, Cases_Submitted),
    by = "Hospital_ID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Actual_Count = replace_na(Actual_Count, 0L),
    difference = Actual_Count - Cases_Submitted
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(raw_data) == 140L,
  sum(is.na(raw_data$hospanon)) == 1L,
  sum(table_s1$Cases_Submitted) == 139,
  all(centre_audit$difference == 0)
)

message("Centre-level case counts verified.")
# Overall case capture: exclude incomplete and missing denominator data
overall_capture <- table_s1 %>%
  filter(
    !Hospital_ID %in% c("A", "I", "Q", "U"),
    !is.na(Eligible_Confirmed),
    Eligible_Confirmed > 0
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    cases_submitted = sum(Cases_Submitted),
    eligible_confirmed = sum(Eligible_Confirmed),
    capture_percent = round(
      100 * cases_submitted / eligible_confirmed, 1
    )
  )

print(overall_capture)
```
```{r}
# TABLE S2: Other drugs administered and emergence ----------------------------

additional_drug_pattern <- paste(
  c(
    "long-acting opioid",
    "morphine",
    "oxycodone",
    "benzodiazepine",
    "clonidine",
    "dexmedetomidine"
  ),
  collapse = "|"
)

table_s2_data <- known_technique %>%
  mutate(
    additional_drugs = if_else(
      str_detect(
        coalesce(drugs, ""),
        regex(additional_drug_pattern, ignore_case = TRUE)
      ),
      "Any specified drug",
      "None of specified drugs"
    )
  )

table_s2 <- table_s2_data %>%
  group_by(anaesthesia, additional_drugs) %>%
  group_modify(~bind_cols(
    tibble(n = nrow(.x)),
    summarise_numeric(.x, "timetowake")
  )) %>%
  ungroup()

print(table_s2, width = Inf)

write_csv(
  table_s2,
  "analysis_outputs/Table_S2_additional_drugs_emergence.csv"
)
```

```{r audit, include=FALSE}
# 9. Audit and reproducibility ----------------------------------

cohort_flow <- tibble(
  step = c(
    "Original responses",
    "Both durations < 480 min",
    "Excluded non-cranial spinal case",
    "Eligible cranial cases",
    "Known predominant maintenance technique"
  ),
  n = c(
    nrow(source_data),
    nrow(short_cases),
    nrow(spinal_cases),
    nrow(raw_data),
    nrow(known_technique)
  )
)

print(cohort_flow)

write_csv(
  cohort_flow,
  "analysis_outputs/cohort_flow.csv"
)

writeLines(
  capture.output(sessionInfo()),
  "analysis_outputs/R_session_info.txt"
)

#Check cohort numbers
print(cohort_flow)
nrow(source_data)
nrow(raw_data)
nrow(known_technique)
#Check main results
print(table1, width = Inf)
print(primary_emergence, width = Inf)
#Check sensitivity analysis
print(mixed_sensitivity, width = Inf)
print(duration_sensitivity, width = Inf)
# Audit checks for descriptive statistics reported in Results.
# raw_data: 140 eligible cases
# known_technique: 139 cases with known maintenance technique


# 1. Overall surgical duration (all 140 cases) ----------------

audit_duration <- summarise_numeric(
  raw_data, "actual_duration"
)

print(audit_duration)

stopifnot(
  audit_duration$n_recorded == 136,
  audit_duration$median == 540,
  audit_duration$Q1 == 480,
  audit_duration$Q3 == 660,
  audit_duration$minimum == 308,
  audit_duration$maximum == 1080
)


# 2. Reasons for anaesthetic choice (139 cases) ----------------

audit_reasons <- known_technique %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    preference_n = sum(
      grepl("Anaesthetist preference",
            coalesce(anaesthetic_factors, ""))
    ),
    duration_n = sum(
      grepl("Duration of surgery",
            coalesce(surgical_factors, ""))
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    preference_pct = round(100 * preference_n / n, 1),
    duration_pct = round(100 * duration_n / n, 1)
  )

print(audit_reasons)

stopifnot(
  audit_reasons$n == 139,
  audit_reasons$preference_n == 121,
  audit_reasons$duration_n == 85,
  audit_reasons$preference_pct == 87.1,
  audit_reasons$duration_pct == 61.2
)


# 3. Postoperative ventilation and early CT (140 cases) -------

audit_complications <- raw_data %>%
  mutate(
    ventilation = grepl(
      "Need for prolonged ventilation",
      coalesce(complications, "")
    ),
    ct = grepl(
      "Need for CT in the first 6h post-op",
      coalesce(complications, "")
    )
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    ventilation_n = sum(ventilation),
    ct_n = sum(ct),
    both_n = sum(ventilation & ct),
    either_n = sum(ventilation | ct)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    either_pct = round(100 * either_n / n, 1)
  )

print(audit_complications)

stopifnot(
  audit_complications$n == 140,
  audit_complications$ventilation_n == 7,
  audit_complications$ct_n == 11,
  audit_complications$both_n == 4,
  audit_complications$either_n == 14,
  audit_complications$either_pct == 10.0
)


# 4. Confirmation ---------------------------------------------

message("Manuscript descriptive statistics: all audit checks passed.")
```
